objects.name: Analytic 2124
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process executing iwconfig or ip link set <wlan> promisc, or loading mac80211 monitor mode, on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset outside normal configuration management activity. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): execve of wireless configuration utility setting monitor/promiscuous mode outside change management window
